title: Translation-compact minimizing sequences and existence of a positive normalized ground state for a Kirchhoff-Choquard system with van der Waals potentials
author: Zhewen Chen; Muzi Li
work: Multiple positive normalized solutions for Kirchhoff type system with van der Waals type potentials
source_version: Electronic Journal of Differential Equations 2026, No. 06, pp. 1--20; DOI 10.58997/ejde.2026.06; publisher version
difficulty_reason: Even with the Hardy-Littlewood-Sobolev, power-type and Choquard-type Gagliardo-Nirenberg inequalities, the Pohozaev/Nehari machinery and the single-component levels sigma_{p_i}^{mu_i} named as prerequisites, the counted theorem requires a source-local compactness mechanism on the L2-constrained radial manifold. The authors must exclude the three loss-of-compactness alternatives for the weak limit by comparing the constrained level sigma(d_1,d_2) with the decoupled levels, which uses the strict negativity of the single-mass levels, their monotonicity in the mass and the splitting of the Kirchhoff gradient term; only the fourth case gives strong convergence, through the negative Lagrange multipliers and the strong-convergence criterion. The vanishing of one component is ruled out by an explicit energy lower bound, so this is a genuine research-level concentration-compactness chain.
